verdicts.reason: A is just a scaled-down copy of the original, centred with wide empty navy bands on both sides. Its illustrations are cramped toward the middle and the 'CREATIVE AGENCY' tagline is tiny, but the symmetric wordmark lockup and the brand feel survive. B splits the lockup: the oversized CLAYTONI sits alone at the left, while 'CREATIVE AGENCY' is jammed against the right edge and collides with the right illustration cluster. B also leaves a large dead gap between its two illustration groups, so it reads as scattered fragments rather than one design.
